hints.title: Strict Peak Condition
hints.text: An index i is a peak if 1 <= i <= n - 2 and mountain[i] is strictly greater than both mountain[i - 1] and mountain[i + 1].

hints.title: Index Bounds
hints.text: Neither the first element (index 0) nor the last element (index n - 1) can ever be a peak.

hints.title: Linear Scan Collection
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to n - 2 and append indices satisfying the strict inequality.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify interior boundaries and compare strictly adjacent elements.
